q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an exhaust silencer?
title: Exhaust silencer carbon footprint per unit
short: Weigh the steel or stainless steel shell, pipes and baffles per silencer and multiply by supplier figures. Add bending, welding, coating and testing energy, then divide the plant's energy by units passed. Count catalysts separately if fitted.

ul: Steel or stainless steel sheet and tube.

p: Report per silencer by vehicle type, and show the catalytic converter as its own line.

example.title: Worked example: exhaust silencer unit per unit (one month)
lines: Plant total: 24,280 / 30,000 = 0.809 kg CO2 per unit
Add steel and catalyst for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
